keyEvents.text: First Half ends, Charlton Athletic 0, Preston North End 0.
Substitution, Charlton Athletic. Millenic Alli replaces Sonny Carey.
Second Half begins Charlton Athletic 0, Preston North End 0.
Léo Leroy (Preston North End) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Goal! Charlton Athletic 1, Preston North End 0. Karlan Grant (Charlton Athletic) left footed shot from the centre of the box to the bottom right corner. Assisted by Millenic Alli with a cross.
Delay in match because of an injury Nathaniel Chalobah (Charlton Athletic).
